dashboards.title: Order Pipeline (Traces)
dashboards.description: Trace-driven view of the order lifecycle. The platform's HTTP and Kafka hops both propagate trace context, so a single submitted order produces one connected trace from Gateway through OMS, Risk, Algo, EMS, and Journal. This dashboard surfaces the slowest, the failed, and the most active.

panels.title: Order submission latency (gateway span p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: Latency of the gateway's order-submission span — what the user actually waited for.

panels.title: Per-stage latency (p95)
panels.description: p95 latency for each pipeline service. Stages with rising lines are bottlenecks.

panels.title: Order events from bus
panels.description: Order lifecycle events as observed by kafka-relay → Loki. Use this when traces are too detailed.

dashboards.title: Service Performance (OTel)
dashboards.description: Per-service request rate, latency, errors, and resource usage — sourced from Deno's built-in OpenTelemetry instrumentation. All panels respect the service variable, so pick a service from the top to scope the view.

panels.title: HTTP request body size by service
panels.description: Bytes received per second on inbound HTTP, broken out by service. Useful for spotting unusually chatty clients.

panels.title: Inter-service request rate
panels.description: Edges of the service graph — who calls whom, how often. Sourced from Tempo's service-graph processor.

panels.title: Inter-service p95 latency
panels.description: p95 latency for each call-pair in the service graph — useful for tracking which downstream calls dominate end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Order Pipeline — Submitted / Filled / Rejected / Expired
Order Funnel (selected window)
panels.description: Counts of orders at each lifecycle stage over the selected time window
